description: This file contains the implementation of an RQL options parser for the Ditto project, parsing options like sort, limit, cursor, and size in RQL syntax, using the parboiled2 parsing library.

classes.name: RqlOptionParser
classes.description: A parser class leveraging parboiled2 to parse RQL options strings into internal Option representations, including support for sort, limit, cursor, and size options.

methods.name: OptionsRoot
methods.description: Entry point for parsing the entire options string into a sequence of 'thingsearch.Option'.

methods.name: Options
methods.description: Parses multiple options separated by commas.

methods.name: Option
methods.description: Parses individual options, which can be sort, limit, cursor, or size.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Parses the sort option, including the property list and sort order.

methods.name: SortProperty
methods.description: Parses a single sort property, including its order and property literal.

methods.name: SortOrder
methods.description: Parses the sort order, either ascending (+) or descending (-).

methods.name: Limit
methods.description: Parses a limit option with offset and count.

methods.name: Cursor
methods.description: Parses a cursor option with a string value.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Parses a size option with an integer size.
